kit.name: Gorski Kotar / Primorje 1550 Modular Architecture Kit
kit.scope: modular components only; no finished individual building assemblies

lumber_mill.rationale: Open saw work with stored roundwood.

reforester.rationale: Humble woodland shelter with tools and sapling guards.

woodcutters_lodge.rationale: Humble timber lodge with fuel-processing yard.

stone_quarry.rationale: Small open quarry bench and lifting gear.

large_quarry.rationale: Expanded cut benches with heavy derrick and sorting floor.

mine.rationale: Shaft/tunnel works use explicit collars, headframes, supports, and hoisting.

clay_pit.rationale: Open clay washing and screening worksite.

charcoal_burner.rationale: Charcoal clamps and a weather shelter define the yard.

smithy.rationale: Masonry workshop identified by open forge and tall flue.

potter_kiln.rationale: Clay-working workshop with an external updraft kiln.

well.rationale: Stone curb, windlass shelter, and buckets.

hunters_hall.rationale: Timber hall with hide handling and hunting tools.

foragers_shed.rationale: Very small timber storage and drying shelter.

fishing_camp.rationale: Riverside dock, dugout, and drying rack.

chapel.rationale: Stone chapel modules include apse, lancet, belfry, and arched oak door.

wayside_shrine.rationale: Small masonry niche and steep timber canopy.

marketplace.rationale: Modular covered stalls and public weighing equipment.

trading_post.rationale: Domestic-commercial shell with shop opening, sign, and loading stock.

town_hall.rationale: Tall limewashed civic frontage with stone steps and public balcony.

stable.rationale: Large timber portal, split doors, hay loading, and hitching rail.

village_storehouse.rationale: Raised stone base, wide doors, and loading hood.

watchtower.rationale: Tall structural posts with platform, hoarding, and ladder.

palisaded_refuge.rationale: Reusable palisade spans, corners, gates, and watch elements.

threshing_barn.rationale: Large ventilated barn with threshing floor and winnowing screen.

pastoral_farmstead.rationale: Stone-and-timber house/barn language with livestock yard modules.

swineherd.rationale: Humble shelter with low pig pen fittings.

monastery.rationale: Stone/tile compound vocabulary with cloister arcade and service production.

brewery.rationale: Fired brewing room, coopered vats, and malt racks.

tavern.rationale: Domestic-commercial building distinguished by gallery and hanging sign.

smokehouse.rationale: Compact dark timber shell with smoke racks and tall flue.

granary.rationale: Raised vermin-resistant storage with bins and vent cupola.

bakery.rationale: Limewashed workshop with masonry oven and firewood.

apiary.rationale: Expandable log-hive stands with low wattle enclosure.

watermill.rationale: River mill signature combines wheel, axle, gears, and dock/walkway.

windmill.rationale: High timber frame with full sail and gear modules.

carpenter.rationale: Open-sided timber workshop with sawpit and bench.

spinning_retting_house.rationale: Flax retting trough and spinning equipment beside a humble workhouse.

weaver.rationale: Domestic workshop with loom and dye vats.

tannery.rationale: Open yard with hide frames, vats, and water handling.

cobbler.rationale: Small domestic workshop with shop opening and cobbler bench.

chandlery.rationale: Wax-working shop with candle rack and small vats.

residence_tier_4.rationale: High-status stone/tile frontage without importing urban fantasy language.

pasture.rationale: Terrain-following fence, gates, and livestock fittings.

vineyard.rationale: Repeated vine rows with dry-stone perimeter.

dry_stone_wall.rationale: Fraction-authored stone spans, corners, and gates.

farm_crop_rye.rationale: Authored rye field strip and marker.

farm_crop_oats.rationale: Authored oats field strip and marker.

farm_crop_fallow.rationale: Authored fallow field strip and marker.

farm_crop_barley.rationale: Authored barley field strip and marker.

farm_crop_flax.rationale: Authored flax field strip and marker.

farm_crop_wheat.rationale: Authored wheat field strip and marker.
